content:
alex: starting a 15m light freeze for v3.8.1 security patch. plan: pin, canary 10% -> 40% -> hold 6m -> unpin if stable. @riley owning metrics.
riley: got it. Preflight: infra quota ok, migrations dry-run ok, feature flag `sec_patch_rollout` off by default. Alerts: watch auth errors and 5xx spikes.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed. Ready to pin on command.
alex: deploy-bot pin model-serving -> v3.8.1-sec by alex.
deploy-bot: Pin recorded at 2899001245. Canary ramp to 40% over 4m.
ops: rollback snippet: kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-serving model=registry/model:v3.8 && kubectl rollout status deploy/model-serving -w
oncall: standing by with runbook open. Trigger if 5xx >4% sustained 2m or auth failures seen.
riley: seeing slight latency blip on canary, p95 +12% but errors flat. Holding.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp complete, no alerts.
alex: holding for 6m observation. If green, unpin and close window.
release-bot: model-serving unpinned at 2899001300 by alex. Light freeze closed, no rollback.
